about: The season simulator: the rest of the Bundesliga season played many times over, by my models' ratings (Dixon-Coles) and by ratings implied by the bookmakers' odds. Written by analysis/pipeline/season_sim.py (never by hand) after each completed matchday. p = chance of each outcome (title: 1st; top4: 1st-4th; europe: 1st-6th; playoff: 16th; drop: 17th-18th); pos = chance of each final position; xpts = expected final points; ptsRange = 10th, 50th and 90th percentile of final points. ratings and fixtures let the page re-run the simulation in the browser.

settings.tiebreak: points, goal difference, goals scored, then at random
